methodologyNotes: Roster covers thirteen bench grinders spanning hobbyist 6 in. models to industrial 10 in. and 2x72 in. belt ("square wheel") machines, verified 2026-08-01 against manufacturer product pages (WEN, Rikon, JET, DeWalt, Baldor/ABB, Metabo, Grizzly, Ryobi) and their own hosted manuals/spec sheets, corroborated by major retailers (Home Depot, Ace Hardware, Acme Tools, Trick-Tools, Burns Tools, Elite Metal Tools, Penn Tool Co, McKeithen's Hardware). motor_power_hp is left null wherever a manufacturer/retailer documents only amperage and never states a horsepower figure (Ryobi BG612G, Skil 3380-01, Craftsman CMXEGAX69434609) rather than inferring HP by analogy to similar 2.1A grinders — null beats a guess. no_load_rpm, arbor_size_in, and wheel_diameter_in are wheel-specific and not applicable to the 2x72 in. belt-driven JET J-4103 (Square Wheel design), so those fields are null for that entry. Prices are the clearest published US MSRP/list figure found; where a manufacturer does not sell direct or publish consumer MSRP (RIKON, Genesis, Metabo, Baldor dealer network), the most consistently cited authorized-dealer list price is used and priceNote records the street-price range actually seen across retailers. Two adversarial corrections were made to the seed list: (1) "Craftsman CMXETAX69434501" does not exist as a product; the visually similar code "CMXEMAX69434501" resolves to a 10 in. single-bevel sliding miter saw (Craftsman/Stanley Black & Decker parts database), not a grinder — the seed was replaced with the actual current Craftsman 6 in. bench grinder, CMXEGAX69434609 (Ace Hardware, Lowe's). (2) The "Wilton Square Wheel" belt grinder (legacy Wilton models 4103/4106/4126AC) has been discontinued under the Wilton brand; JPW Industries, which owns both the Wilton and JET brands, now sells the identical American-made machine exclusively as the JET J-4103 (SKU 577000, plus a newer variable-speed JET SWG-272VS sibling) — brand corrected from Wilton to JET, entry retained as the direct successor product a 2026 buyer would actually find for sale. Separately, JET's own current product page displays SKU 577102 under the name "JBG-8B" even though it is still marketed and sold everywhere else (Home Depot, Amazon, Trick-Tools, US Tool Depot) as "JBG-8A" — both names denote the identical machine and the entry is kept as JBG-8A to match dominant retail usage. accessedAt 2026-08-01 throughout.

products.name: Genesis GBG800L 8 in. Bench Grinder with Dual Flexible Lights
products.priceNote: Current retail (McKeithen's Hardware); street price commonly seen $99.65-$127.19 across retailers. Genesis does not display a fixed MSRP on genesispowertools.com.

products.name: Metabo DS 200 Plus 8 in. Heavy Duty Bench Grinder
products.priceNote: Representative US authorized-dealer price (The Power Tool Store); other retailers range roughly $236-$480 (Mister Worker, eBay). Metabo does not publish a direct consumer MSRP.

specs.wheel_type: aluminum oxide, dual grit (36P/60N grit), 1 in. wide

products.provenance: Metabo's official DS 200 Plus (604200420) page states 600 W rated input / 450 W rated output, 110-120V, 3,600 rpm no-load, 200 x 25 x 32mm (7-7/8 x 1 x 1-1/4 in.) wheels, and 17.5 kg (38.6 lb) weight. motor_power_hp (0.6) is derived from the page's own 450 W rated-output figure (450 W ÷ 746 W/hp); Metabo does not state a horsepower figure directly, only watts. Retailer titles (Toolmarts, AAA Abrasives) independently cite "5.0 AMP," consistent with 600 W ÷ 120 V = 5.0 A. Price could not be confirmed via direct manufacturer fetch (Metabo does not list consumer pricing); $329 from The Power Tool Store used as representative, with the wider $236-$480 street range noted.

products.name: JET J-4103 2 in. x 72 in. Square Wheel Belt Grinder (successor to the Wilton Square Wheel Grinder)
products.priceNote: Current retail at Burns Tools and Advanced Machinery ($2,699.00, list $3,315.91); other industrial distributors (Midwest Technology) list up to $3,131.40

specs.wheel_type: 2 in. x 72 in. cloth-backed abrasive belt on a flat platen with idler wheels (no fixed-diameter grinding wheel); accepts optional 1-1/2 in. or 3 in. contact wheels

products.provenance: CORRECTED FROM SEED: the seed "Wilton Square Wheel" grinder (Wilton models 4103/4106/4126AC) is discontinued under the Wilton brand. JPW Industries, the parent company of both Wilton and JET, now sells the identical made-in-USA flat-platen "square wheel" belt grinder exclusively as the JET J-4103 (SKU 577000; JET's own page and every current retailer, including former Wilton-parts sellers like Trick-Tools, now list this design only under the JET name). JET's official page confirms 1 HP, 115/230V 1-phase, 2 x 72 in. belt, 17 x 31 x 17 in. overall dimensions, and 116 lb weight; the design uses a flat platen and idler/contact wheels rather than a fixed-diameter grinding wheel or a conventional adjustable tool rest, so wheel_diameter_in, no_load_rpm, arbor_size_in, and includes_tool_rest are null/false as not applicable to this belt-grinder format. Price corroborated identically at $2,699.00 across Burns Tools and Advanced Machinery.

products.name: Craftsman CMXEGAX69434609 6 in. Bench Grinder

specs.wheel_type: aluminum oxide, dual grit (36/60 grit), up to 3/4 in. wide

products.provenance: CORRECTED FROM SEED: the seed model number "CMXETAX69434501" does not correspond to any Craftsman product. The visually similar code "CMXEMAX69434501" resolves (per powertoolsafe.com's model lookup, corroborated by manualslib and general search) to a 10 in. single-bevel sliding miter saw, not a bench grinder — not the intended product. The seed was replaced with Craftsman's actual current 6 in. bench grinder, CMXEGAX69434609 (also cross-listed as CMXEGAR500/CFT-6in on Lowe's), confirmed on Ace Hardware ($99.99) with a 2.1A motor, 6 in. wheel, 5/8 in. arbor, 3,600 RPM, and 36/60-grit wheel set, corroborated on Zoro and MaxWarehouse. Craftsman's own materials state amperage (2.1A) but no horsepower figure was found on any fetched source, so motor_power_hp and weight_lb are left null rather than assumed by analogy to similarly-rated competitors.
